crossRefs.note: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

people.name: Azzan
people.line: Father of Paltiel, a leader from the tribe of Issachar.

people.name: Issachar
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe

people.name: Paltiel
people.line: Leader from Issachar, helped divide Canaan

translations.kjv: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
